data.title: Telling Time — Starter · Lesson 3
data.subject: time
data.lyrics:
Let's go

[Intro]
New neighbors just moved in, let's say hello

[Hook]
I see you… Te veo  
Let's meet… Vamos a conocernos  
Nice to meet you… Mucho gusto  
Time to go… Es hora de irnos  
Let's learn the time today.

[Verse]
The clock is ticking, can you tell?  
At five to eight… A las ocho menos cinco  
We're almost there, can you spell?  
Twenty minutes before… Veinte minutos antes  
The sun is shining, feeling fine  
At ten past ten… A las diez y diez  
We're having fun, it's party time  
Forty minutes later… Cuarenta minutos después  

[Hook]
I see you… Te veo  
Let's meet… Vamos a conocernos  
Nice to meet you… Mucho gusto  
Time to go… Es hora de irnos  
Let's learn the time today.

[Verse]
The evening's here, it's getting late  
Around six o'clock… Cerca de las seis  
Dinner's ready, don't be late  
At nine o'clock sharp… A las nueve en punto  
We're eating, laughing, having a blast  
At dinner time… A la hora de la cena  
The night is young, let's make it last

vocab.es: a la hora de la cena
